dashboard.label: SRE Overview
dashboard.description: Service error rates, mean time to restore, capacity forecast, and failed-login activity for on-call SRE review. Pairs with searches/ and alerts/ in this repo.

search.query: index=web sourcetype=access_combined | eval service=coalesce(service, "unknown") | stats count by service | sort service

index=web sourcetype=access_combined | eval service=coalesce(service, "unknown") | eval is_error=if(status>=500, 1, 0) | bin _time span=5m | stats sum(is_error) as errors count as total_requests by _time, service | eval error_rate=round(errors / total_requests * 100, 2) | search service=$service$ | timechart span=5m avg(error_rate) as error_pct by service | fillnull value=0

index=tickets sourcetype=ticket_events status=resolved | eval duration_min=round((resolved_time - opened_time) / 60, 1) | where duration_min > 0 | eval priority=upper(priority) | stats count as incidents avg(duration_min) as avg_mttr_min median(duration_min) as p50_mttr_min perc95(duration_min) as p95_mttr_min by priority | search priority=$priority$ | eval avg_mttr_min=round(avg_mttr_min, 1) | sort - incidents

index=metrics sourcetype=perf | bin _time span=1d | stats max(disk_used_pct) as disk_pct by _time, host, mount | sort _time | predict disk_pct as disk_forecast future_timespan=30 holdback=0 algorithm=LL | eval forecast_date=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d") | where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-14d@d") | timechart span=1d max(disk_pct) as actual max(disk_forecast) as forecast by mount

index=auth sourcetype=secure action="failed_login" | bin _time span=10m | stats count as failures dc(user) as distinct_users values(user) as targeted_users by _time, src_ip | where failures > 20 | join type=left src_ip [ search index=auth sourcetype=secure action="accepted_login" | stats count as successes by src_ip ] | fillnull value=0 successes | eval verdict=case(successes > 0, "COMPROMISE SUSPECTED", distinct_users > 5, "password spray", 1=1, "brute force") | sort - failures | table _time, src_ip, failures, distinct_users, targeted_users, successes, verdict
